parameters.description:
`msg-to-gotify` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Gotify server — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Gotify servers — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Gotify servers bound per enrollment.

In your Gotify server's web UI, open Apps and create a new application (or use an existing one); Gotify generates a token for it. Set that token as GOTIFY_TOKEN — the gateway uses it to authenticate when posting messages to your Gotify server.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Gotify destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your own Gotify server
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Gotify server by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

base_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's GOTIFY_BASE_URL value (same format as GOTIFY_BASE_URL)

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Gotify token
